_comment: Per-file sha256 manifest of the `sglang/` package tree as INSTALLED from the
PyPI wheel, for the SGLang oracle pin. Owning row SGLANG-ORACLE-LEASE-WHEEL,
spec .agents/specs/sglang-wheel-in-lease.md, issue #1265.
WHAT THIS IS FOR. `sglang.__commit_id__` is None in this wheel, so the
installed package carries NO runtime assertion of the commit it was built
from. This manifest is that assertion. A staging job re-derives it from the
installed tree and aborts non-zero on ANY mismatch, missing file or extra
file, before it serves a token.
WHY IT BINDS THE PIN. Every one of the 3335 regular files below that also
exists under `python/sglang/` in the GitHub source tarball at the pin is
BYTE-IDENTICAL to it: 0 differing, 0 only-in-source. `.clang-format` under
`srt/mem_cache/cpp_radix_tree/` is a symlink in the repository to
`sgl-kernel/.clang-format`, which the build resolves into a real file, and
its content matches the link target, giving 3336 of 3336. The two remaining
entries are build products with no source counterpart: the generated
`_version.py` and the compiled Rust gRPC extension
`srt/grpc/_core.cpython-312-aarch64-linux-gnu.so`.
SCOPE. cp312 and linux-aarch64 ONLY. The gRPC extension file name carries
the interpreter tag and the machine tag, so another interpreter or another
architecture needs its own manifest and must not be checked against this one.
NOT COVERED. `sgl_kernel` is a separately versioned package and is asserted
by the `kernel_wheel` sha256 below, not by the `files` map.
EXCLUDE `__pycache__/` when re-deriving: pip writes byte-code beside the
source and the wheel does not carry it.
Re-derive from the wheel, without installing anything, by hashing every
member of the zip whose name starts with `sglang/` and does not end in `/`.
